title: Best Massage Chair (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Sources from Consumer Reports, Tom's Guide, CNET, and Yahoo Health were reviewed. Only CNET provided a specific product name (BodyFriend Rex-L). Other sources mentioned brands or categories but did not provide enough detail for specific product entries in this format.
